title: Tyrannosaurus - Wander Encyclopedia
text:
Tyrannosaurus rex was a huge meat-eating dinosaur. It lived in western North America at the end of the Cretaceous period, about 68 to 66 million years ago.
An adult was about 12 meters long and weighed more than an elephant. Its name means "tyrant lizard king".
Hunting
T. rex was a powerful predator. It hunted and killed big plant-eating dinosaurs such as Edmontosaurus and Triceratops, and it also ate animals that were already dead.
Its teeth were as long as bananas, and its bite was strong enough to crush bone. Scientists have found Triceratops bones with T. rex tooth marks in them.
Small arms, big head
Its arms were tiny, only about 1 meter long, but they were very strong. Its huge head had an excellent sense of smell for finding food.
Fossils
The most complete skeleton, nicknamed Sue, was found in South Dakota in 1990. T. rex died out with the other non-bird dinosaurs 66 million years ago.
